package com.example.ancapp

import com.ionspin.kotlin.bignum.decimal.BigDecimal
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.FhirEngine
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.FhirEngineProvider
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.get
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.search.search
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.AcceptLocalConflictResolver
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.ConflictResolver
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.DownloadWorkManager
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.FhirSyncTask
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.SyncJobStatus
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.download.ResourceParamsBasedDownloadWorkManager
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.runSync
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.upload.HttpCreateMethod
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.upload.HttpUpdateMethod
import dev.ohs.fhir.engine.sync.upload.UploadStrategy
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Annotation
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Code
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.CodeableConcept
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Coding
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.DateTime
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Decimal
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Encounter
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Enumeration
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.FhirDateTime
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Markdown
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Observation
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Patient
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Period
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Quantity
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Questionnaire
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.QuestionnaireResponse
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Reference
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Resource
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.String as FhirString
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.Uri
import dev.ohs.fhir.model.r4.terminologies.ResourceType
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.Period as JavaPeriod
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

data class PatientSummary(
  val id: String,
  val identifier: String?,
  val name: String,
  val birthDate: LocalDate?,
  val ageYears: Int?,
  val estimatedDueDate: LocalDate?,
  val currentPregnancyWeeks: Int?,
  val lastVisitDate: LocalDate?,
)

data class AncVisitRecord(
  val encounterId: String,
  val date: LocalDate?,
  val dateDisplay: String,
  val gestationalAgeWeeks: Int?,
  val weightKg: String?,
  val bpSystolic: Int?,
  val bpDiastolic: Int?,
  val hemoglobinGdl: String?,
  val dangerSigns: List<String>,
  val notes: String?,
) {
  val bpDisplay: String?
    get() =
      if (bpSystolic != null && bpDiastolic != null) {
        "$bpSystolic/$bpDiastolic"
      } else {
        bpSystolic?.toString() ?: bpDiastolic?.toString()
      }
}

data class NewVisitInput(
  val visitDate: String,
  val gestationalAgeWeeks: Int?,
  val weightKg: Double?,
  val bpSystolic: Int?,
  val bpDiastolic: Int?,
  val dangerSigns: List<Coding>,
  val notes: String?,
  val questionnaireResponse: QuestionnaireResponse? = null,
)

class AncRepository(private val fhirEngine: FhirEngine) {

  private val fhirJson = Json {
    explicitNulls = false
    encodeDefaults = false
    ignoreUnknownKeys = true
  }

  suspend fun syncWithServer(): SyncJobStatus {
    val task =
      object : FhirSyncTask {
        override fun getFhirEngine(): FhirEngine = fhirEngine

        override fun getDownloadWorkManager(): DownloadWorkManager =
          ResourceParamsBasedDownloadWorkManager(
            syncParams =
              mapOf(
                ResourceType.Patient to emptyMap(),
                ResourceType.Encounter to emptyMap(),
                ResourceType.Observation to emptyMap(),
                ResourceType.Questionnaire to emptyMap(),
                ResourceType.QuestionnaireResponse to emptyMap(),
              ),
            context =
              object : ResourceParamsBasedDownloadWorkManager.TimestampContext {
                override suspend fun saveLastUpdatedTimestamp(
                  resourceType: ResourceType,
                  timestamp: String?,
                ) {}

                override suspend fun getLasUpdateTimestamp(resourceType: ResourceType): String? =
                  null
              },
          )

        override fun getConflictResolver(): ConflictResolver = AcceptLocalConflictResolver

        override fun getUploadStrategy(): UploadStrategy =
          UploadStrategy.forIndividualRequest(
            methodForCreate = HttpCreateMethod.PUT,
            methodForUpdate = HttpUpdateMethod.PATCH,
            squash = true,
          )
      }
    return task.runSync(taskName = null, onProgress = {})
  }

  suspend fun getAncQuestionnaireJson(): String {
    val questionnaire: Questionnaire =
      try {
        fhirEngine.get<Questionnaire>("anc-contact")
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        fhirEngine.search<Questionnaire> {}.firstOrNull()?.resource ?: defaultAncQuestionnaire()
      }
    return fhirJson.encodeToString(Resource.serializer(), questionnaire)
  }

  suspend fun getPatientSummaries(today: LocalDate = LocalDate.now()): List<PatientSummary> {
    val patients = fhirEngine.search<Patient> {}.map { it.resource }
    val encounters = fhirEngine.search<Encounter> {}.map { it.resource }
    val observations = fhirEngine.search<Observation> {}.map { it.resource }

    return patients
      .map { patient ->
        val patientId = patient.id ?: ""
        val patientRef = "Patient/$patientId"
        val patientObs =
          observations.filter { obs ->
            obs.subject?.reference?.value == patientRef ||
              obs.subject?.reference?.value?.endsWith("/$patientId") == true
          }
        val patientEncounters =
          encounters.filter { enc ->
            enc.subject?.reference?.value == patientRef ||
              enc.subject?.reference?.value?.endsWith("/$patientId") == true
          }

        val name = formatPatientName(patient)
        val identifier = patient.identifier.firstOrNull()?.value?.value
        val birthDate = parseLocalDate(patient.birthDate?.value?.toString())
        val ageYears = birthDate?.let { JavaPeriod.between(it, today).years }

        val eddObs =
          patientObs
            .filter { obs -> obs.hasCode(LOINC_EDD) }
            .maxByOrNull { obs -> extractObservationDate(obs) ?: LocalDate.MIN }
        val eddDate = eddObs?.let { extractValueDate(it) }

        val gaObs =
          patientObs
            .filter { obs -> obs.hasCode(LOINC_GESTATIONAL_AGE) }
            .maxByOrNull { obs -> extractObservationDate(obs) ?: LocalDate.MIN }

        val currentWeeks =
          when {
            eddDate != null -> {
              val daysUntilDue = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(today, eddDate)
              val daysElapsed = 280L - daysUntilDue
              (daysElapsed / 7L).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
            }
            gaObs != null -> {
              val recordedWeeks = extractQuantityInt(gaObs) ?: 0
              val obsDate = extractObservationDate(gaObs)
              if (obsDate != null) {
                val extraWeeks = (ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(obsDate, today) / 7L).toInt()
                (recordedWeeks + extraWeeks).coerceAtLeast(0)
              } else {
                recordedWeeks
              }
            }
            else -> null
          }

        val lastVisitDate =
          patientEncounters.mapNotNull { extractEncounterDate(it) }.maxOrNull()
            ?: patientObs.mapNotNull { extractObservationDate(it) }.maxOrNull()

        PatientSummary(
          id = patientId,
          identifier = identifier,
          name = name,
          birthDate = birthDate,
          ageYears = ageYears,
          estimatedDueDate = eddDate,
          currentPregnancyWeeks = currentWeeks,
          lastVisitDate = lastVisitDate,
        )
      }
      .sortedWith(
        compareBy<PatientSummary, LocalDate?>(nullsLast()) { it.estimatedDueDate }
          .thenBy { it.name },
      )
  }

  suspend fun getPatientDetail(
    patientId: String,
    today: LocalDate = LocalDate.now(),
  ): Pair<PatientSummary?, List<AncVisitRecord>> {
    val summaries = getPatientSummaries(today)
    val summary = summaries.find { it.id == patientId }

    val patientRef = "Patient/$patientId"
    val encounters =
      fhirEngine
        .search<Encounter> {}
        .map { it.resource }
        .filter { enc ->
          enc.subject?.reference?.value == patientRef ||
            enc.subject?.reference?.value?.endsWith("/$patientId") == true
        }

    val observations =
      fhirEngine
        .search<Observation> {}
        .map { it.resource }
        .filter { obs ->
          obs.subject?.reference?.value == patientRef ||
            obs.subject?.reference?.value?.endsWith("/$patientId") == true
        }

    val visits =
      encounters
        .map { encounter ->
          val encId = encounter.id ?: ""
          val encRef = "Encounter/$encId"
          val encObs =
            observations.filter { obs ->
              obs.encounter?.reference?.value == encRef ||
                obs.encounter?.reference?.value?.endsWith("/$encId") == true
            }

          val visitDate =
            extractEncounterDate(encounter)
              ?: encObs.firstNotNullOfOrNull { extractObservationDate(it) }
          val dateDisplay =
            visitDate?.toString()
              ?: encounter.period?.start?.value?.toString()?.take(10)
              ?: "Unknown date"

          val weightObs = encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(LOINC_WEIGHT) }
          val weightKg = weightObs?.let { extractQuantityString(it) }

          val bpPanelObs = encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(LOINC_BP_PANEL) }
          val systolicFromPanel =
            bpPanelObs
              ?.component
              ?.firstOrNull { comp ->
                comp.code.coding.any { it.code?.value == LOINC_BP_SYSTOLIC }
              }
              ?.value
              ?.asQuantity()
              ?.value
              ?.value
              ?.value
              ?.intValue(false)
          val diastolicFromPanel =
            bpPanelObs
              ?.component
              ?.firstOrNull { comp ->
                comp.code.coding.any { it.code?.value == LOINC_BP_DIASTOLIC }
              }
              ?.value
              ?.asQuantity()
              ?.value
              ?.value
              ?.value
              ?.intValue(false)

          val standaloneSystolic =
            encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(LOINC_BP_SYSTOLIC) }?.let { extractQuantityInt(it) }
          val standaloneDiastolic =
            encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(LOINC_BP_DIASTOLIC) }?.let { extractQuantityInt(it) }

          val bpSystolic = systolicFromPanel ?: standaloneSystolic
          val bpDiastolic = diastolicFromPanel ?: standaloneDiastolic

          val hbObs = encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(LOINC_HEMOGLOBIN) }
          val hbGdl = hbObs?.let { extractQuantityString(it) }

          val gaObs = encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(LOINC_GESTATIONAL_AGE) }
          val gaWeeks = gaObs?.let { extractQuantityInt(it) }

          val dangerObsList =
            encObs.filter {
              it.hasCode(CODE_DANGER_SIGNS) ||
                it.code.coding.any { c -> c.system?.value == SYSTEM_DANGER_SIGNS }
            }
          val dangerSigns =
            dangerObsList
              .flatMap { obs ->
                val cc = obs.value?.asCodeableConcept()?.value
                val fromCc =
                  cc?.coding?.mapNotNull { it.display?.value ?: it.code?.value }.orEmpty()
                val fromText = listOfNotNull(cc?.text?.value)
                (fromCc + fromText).distinct()
              }
              .distinct()

          val notesObs = encObs.firstOrNull { it.hasCode(CODE_CLINICAL_NOTES) }
          val notesFromObs =
            notesObs?.value?.asString()?.value?.value
              ?: encObs
                .flatMap { it.note }
                .mapNotNull { it.text.value }
                .firstOrNull { it.isNotBlank() }

          AncVisitRecord(
            encounterId = encId,
            date = visitDate,
            dateDisplay = dateDisplay,
            gestationalAgeWeeks = gaWeeks,
            weightKg = weightKg,
            bpSystolic = bpSystolic,
            bpDiastolic = bpDiastolic,
            hemoglobinGdl = hbGdl,
            dangerSigns = dangerSigns,
            notes = notesFromObs,
          )
        }
        .sortedWith(
          compareByDescending<AncVisitRecord, LocalDate?>(nullsLast()) { it.date }
            .thenByDescending { it.encounterId },
        )

    return summary to visits
  }

  suspend fun saveAncVisit(patientId: String, input: NewVisitInput) {
    val suffix = UUID.randomUUID().toString().take(8)
    val encounterId = "anc-enc-$suffix"
    val patientReference = Reference(reference = FhirString(value = "Patient/$patientId"))
    val encounterReference = Reference(reference = FhirString(value = "Encounter/$encounterId"))

    val cleanDateStr = input.visitDate.trim().take(10).ifBlank { LocalDate.now().toString() }
    val fhirDateTime =
      try {
        FhirDateTime.fromString(cleanDateStr)
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        FhirDateTime.fromString(LocalDate.now().toString())
      }

    val encounter =
      Encounter(
        id = encounterId,
        status = Enumeration(value = Encounter.EncounterStatus.Finished),
        `class` =
          Coding(
            system = Uri(value = "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode"),
            code = Code(value = "AMB"),
            display = FhirString(value = "ambulatory"),
          ),
        type =
          listOf(
            CodeableConcept(
              text = FhirString(value = "Antenatal care contact"),
            ),
          ),
        subject = patientReference,
        period =
          Period(
            start = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime),
            end = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime),
          ),
      )

    val resourcesToCreate = mutableListOf<Resource>(encounter)

    val vitalSignsCategory =
      listOf(
        CodeableConcept(
          coding =
            listOf(
              Coding(
                system =
                  Uri(value = "http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category"),
                code = Code(value = "vital-signs"),
                display = FhirString(value = "Vital Signs"),
              ),
            ),
        ),
      )

    val noteList =
      if (!input.notes.isNullOrBlank()) {
        listOf(Annotation(text = Markdown(value = input.notes.trim())))
      } else {
        emptyList()
      }

    if (input.gestationalAgeWeeks != null) {
      val gaObs =
        Observation(
          id = "anc-obs-ga-$suffix",
          status = Enumeration(value = Observation.ObservationStatus.Final),
          code =
            CodeableConcept(
              coding =
                listOf(
                  Coding(
                    system = Uri(value = "http://loinc.org"),
                    code = Code(value = LOINC_GESTATIONAL_AGE),
                    display = FhirString(value = "Gestational age"),
                  ),
                ),
              text = FhirString(value = "Gestational age"),
            ),
          subject = patientReference,
          encounter = encounterReference,
          effective = Observation.Effective.DateTime(value = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime)),
          value =
            Observation.Value.Quantity(
              value =
                Quantity(
                  value = Decimal(value = BigDecimal.fromInt(input.gestationalAgeWeeks)),
                  unit = FhirString(value = "wk"),
                  system = Uri(value = "http://unitsofmeasure.org"),
                  code = Code(value = "wk"),
                ),
            ),
        )
      resourcesToCreate.add(gaObs)
    }

    if (input.weightKg != null) {
      val weightBigDecimal = BigDecimal.parseString(input.weightKg.toString())
      val weightObs =
        Observation(
          id = "anc-obs-weight-$suffix",
          status = Enumeration(value = Observation.ObservationStatus.Final),
          category = vitalSignsCategory,
          code =
            CodeableConcept(
              coding =
                listOf(
                  Coding(
                    system = Uri(value = "http://loinc.org"),
                    code = Code(value = LOINC_WEIGHT),
                    display = FhirString(value = "Body weight"),
                  ),
                ),
              text = FhirString(value = "Body weight"),
            ),
          subject = patientReference,
          encounter = encounterReference,
          effective = Observation.Effective.DateTime(value = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime)),
          value =
            Observation.Value.Quantity(
              value =
                Quantity(
                  value = Decimal(value = weightBigDecimal),
                  unit = FhirString(value = "kg"),
                  system = Uri(value = "http://unitsofmeasure.org"),
                  code = Code(value = "kg"),
                ),
            ),
        )
      resourcesToCreate.add(weightObs)
    }

    if (input.bpSystolic != null || input.bpDiastolic != null) {
      val components = mutableListOf<Observation.Component>()
      if (input.bpSystolic != null) {
        components.add(
          Observation.Component(
            code =
              CodeableConcept(
                coding =
                  listOf(
                    Coding(
                      system = Uri(value = "http://loinc.org"),
                      code = Code(value = LOINC_BP_SYSTOLIC),
                      display = FhirString(value = "Systolic blood pressure"),
                    ),
                  ),
              ),
            value =
              Observation.Component.Value.Quantity(
                value =
                  Quantity(
                    value = Decimal(value = BigDecimal.fromInt(input.bpSystolic)),
                    unit = FhirString(value = "mmHg"),
                    system = Uri(value = "http://unitsofmeasure.org"),
                    code = Code(value = "mm[Hg]"),
                  ),
              ),
          ),
        )
      }
      if (input.bpDiastolic != null) {
        components.add(
          Observation.Component(
            code =
              CodeableConcept(
                coding =
                  listOf(
                    Coding(
                      system = Uri(value = "http://loinc.org"),
                      code = Code(value = LOINC_BP_DIASTOLIC),
                      display = FhirString(value = "Diastolic blood pressure"),
                    ),
                  ),
              ),
            value =
              Observation.Component.Value.Quantity(
                value =
                  Quantity(
                    value = Decimal(value = BigDecimal.fromInt(input.bpDiastolic)),
                    unit = FhirString(value = "mmHg"),
                    system = Uri(value = "http://unitsofmeasure.org"),
                    code = Code(value = "mm[Hg]"),
                  ),
              ),
          ),
        )
      }
      val bpObs =
        Observation(
          id = "anc-obs-bp-$suffix",
          status = Enumeration(value = Observation.ObservationStatus.Final),
          category = vitalSignsCategory,
          code =
            CodeableConcept(
              coding =
                listOf(
                  Coding(
                    system = Uri(value = "http://loinc.org"),
                    code = Code(value = LOINC_BP_PANEL),
                    display =
                      FhirString(value = "Blood pressure panel with all children optional"),
                  ),
                ),
              text = FhirString(value = "Blood pressure"),
            ),
          subject = patientReference,
          encounter = encounterReference,
          effective = Observation.Effective.DateTime(value = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime)),
          component = components,
        )
      resourcesToCreate.add(bpObs)
    }

    if (input.dangerSigns.isNotEmpty()) {
      val dangerObs =
        Observation(
          id = "anc-obs-danger-$suffix",
          status = Enumeration(value = Observation.ObservationStatus.Final),
          code =
            CodeableConcept(
              coding =
                listOf(
                  Coding(
                    system = Uri(value = SYSTEM_DANGER_SIGNS),
                    code = Code(value = CODE_DANGER_SIGNS),
                    display = FhirString(value = "Danger signs present"),
                  ),
                ),
              text = FhirString(value = "Danger signs present"),
            ),
          subject = patientReference,
          encounter = encounterReference,
          effective = Observation.Effective.DateTime(value = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime)),
          value =
            Observation.Value.CodeableConcept(
              value =
                CodeableConcept(
                  coding = input.dangerSigns,
                  text =
                    FhirString(
                      value =
                        input.dangerSigns.mapNotNull { it.display?.value ?: it.code?.value }
                          .joinToString(", "),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
      resourcesToCreate.add(dangerObs)
    }

    if (!input.notes.isNullOrBlank()) {
      val notesObs =
        Observation(
          id = "anc-obs-notes-$suffix",
          status = Enumeration(value = Observation.ObservationStatus.Final),
          code =
            CodeableConcept(
              coding =
                listOf(
                  Coding(
                    system = Uri(value = "http://loinc.org"),
                    code = Code(value = CODE_CLINICAL_NOTES),
                    display = FhirString(value = "Clinical notes"),
                  ),
                ),
              text = FhirString(value = "Notes"),
            ),
          subject = patientReference,
          encounter = encounterReference,
          effective = Observation.Effective.DateTime(value = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime)),
          value = Observation.Value.String(value = FhirString(value = input.notes.trim())),
          note = noteList,
        )
      resourcesToCreate.add(notesObs)
    }

    input.questionnaireResponse?.let { qr ->
      val qrToSave =
        qr
          .toBuilder()
          .apply {
            id = "anc-qr-$suffix"
            status =
              Enumeration(
                value = QuestionnaireResponse.QuestionnaireResponseStatus.Completed,
              )
            subject = patientReference.toBuilder()
            encounter = encounterReference.toBuilder()
            authored = DateTime(value = fhirDateTime).toBuilder()
          }
          .build()
      resourcesToCreate.add(qrToSave)
    }

    fhirEngine.create(*resourcesToCreate.toTypedArray())

    try {
      syncWithServer()
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      // Local persistence already succeeded; server upload will retry on next sync
    }
  }

  fun parseQuestionnaireResponse(response: QuestionnaireResponse): NewVisitInput {
    val allItems = flattenResponseItems(response.item)

    val visitDateAnswer =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "visit-date" }
        ?.answer
        ?.firstOrNull()
        ?.value
        ?.asDate()
        ?.value
        ?.value
        ?.toString()
        ?: LocalDate.now().toString()

    val gaWeeks =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "gestational-age" }
        ?.answer
        ?.firstOrNull()
        ?.value
        ?.asInteger()
        ?.value
        ?.value

    val weightKg =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "weight" }
        ?.answer
        ?.firstOrNull()
        ?.value
        ?.asDecimal()
        ?.value
        ?.value
        ?.doubleValue(false)

    val bpSystolic =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "bp-systolic" }
        ?.answer
        ?.firstOrNull()
        ?.value
        ?.asInteger()
        ?.value
        ?.value

    val bpDiastolic =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "bp-diastolic" }
        ?.answer
        ?.firstOrNull()
        ?.value
        ?.asInteger()
        ?.value
        ?.value

    val dangerSigns =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "danger-signs" }
        ?.answer
        ?.mapNotNull { it.value?.asCoding()?.value }
        .orEmpty()

    val notes =
      allItems
        .firstOrNull { it.linkId.value == "notes" }
        ?.answer
        ?.firstOrNull()
        ?.value
        ?.asString()
        ?.value
        ?.value

    return NewVisitInput(
      visitDate = visitDateAnswer,
      gestationalAgeWeeks = gaWeeks,
      weightKg = weightKg,
      bpSystolic = bpSystolic,
      bpDiastolic = bpDiastolic,
      dangerSigns = dangerSigns,
      notes = notes,
      questionnaireResponse = response,
    )
  }

  private fun flattenResponseItems(
    items: List<QuestionnaireResponse.Item>,
  ): List<QuestionnaireResponse.Item> {
    val result = mutableListOf<QuestionnaireResponse.Item>()
    for (item in items) {
      result.add(item)
      result.addAll(flattenResponseItems(item.item))
      for (ans in item.answer) {
        result.addAll(flattenResponseItems(ans.item))
      }
    }
    return result
  }

  private fun formatPatientName(patient: Patient): String {
    val humanName = patient.name.firstOrNull() ?: return "Unknown Patient"
    val given = humanName.given.mapNotNull { it.value }.joinToString(" ")
    val family = humanName.family?.value.orEmpty()
    val full = "$given $family".trim()
    return full.ifEmpty { humanName.text?.value ?: "Unknown Patient" }
  }

  private fun Observation.hasCode(targetCode: String): Boolean =
    code.coding.any { it.code?.value == targetCode }

  private fun extractObservationDate(obs: Observation): LocalDate? {
    val effStr = obs.effective?.asDateTime()?.value?.value?.toString()
    return parseLocalDate(effStr)
  }

  private fun extractValueDate(obs: Observation): LocalDate? {
    val valStr = obs.value?.asDateTime()?.value?.value?.toString()
    return parseLocalDate(valStr)
  }

  private fun extractEncounterDate(encounter: Encounter): LocalDate? {
    val startStr = encounter.period?.start?.value?.toString()
    return parseLocalDate(startStr)
  }

  private fun extractQuantityString(obs: Observation): String? {
    val qty = obs.value?.asQuantity()?.value?.value?.value ?: return null
    return qty.toStringExpanded()
  }

  private fun extractQuantityInt(obs: Observation): Int? {
    val qty = obs.value?.asQuantity()?.value?.value?.value ?: return null
    return qty.intValue(false)
  }

  private fun parseLocalDate(raw: String?): LocalDate? {
    if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) return null
    return try {
      LocalDate.parse(raw.take(10))
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      null
    }
  }

  private fun defaultAncQuestionnaire(): Questionnaire {
    val fallbackJson =
      """
      {
        "resourceType": "Questionnaire",
        "id": "anc-contact",
        "url": "http://example.org/fhir/Questionnaire/anc-contact",
        "version": "0.1.0",
        "name": "AncContact",
        "title": "ANC Contact Visit",
        "status": "active",
        "subjectType": [ "Patient" ],
        "item": [
          {
            "linkId": "visit-date",
            "text": "Visit date",
            "type": "date",
            "required": true
          },
          {
            "linkId": "gestational-age",
            "text": "Gestational age (weeks)",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          {
            "linkId": "vitals",
            "text": "Vital signs",
            "type": "group",
            "item": [
              {
                "linkId": "weight",
                "code": [ { "system": "http://loinc.org", "code": "29463-7", "display": "Body weight" } ],
                "text": "Weight (kg)",
                "type": "decimal"
              },
              {
                "linkId": "bp-systolic",
                "code": [ { "system": "http://loinc.org", "code": "8480-6", "display": "Systolic blood pressure" } ],
                "text": "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
                "type": "integer"
              },
              {
                "linkId": "bp-diastolic",
                "code": [ { "system": "http://loinc.org", "code": "8462-4", "display": "Diastolic blood pressure" } ],
                "text": "Diastolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
                "type": "integer"
              }
            ]
          },
          {
            "linkId": "danger-signs",
            "text": "Danger signs present",
            "type": "choice",
            "repeats": true,
            "answerOption": [
              { "valueCoding": { "system": "urn:example:anc-danger-signs", "code": "none", "display": "None" } },
              { "valueCoding": { "system": "urn:example:anc-danger-signs", "code": "vaginal-bleeding", "display": "Vaginal bleeding" } },
              { "valueCoding": { "system": "urn:example:anc-danger-signs", "code": "severe-headache", "display": "Severe headache" } },
              { "valueCoding": { "system": "urn:example:anc-danger-signs", "code": "blurred-vision", "display": "Blurred vision" } },
              { "valueCoding": { "system": "urn:example:anc-danger-signs", "code": "fever", "display": "Fever" } }
            ]
          },
          {
            "linkId": "notes",
            "text": "Notes",
            "type": "text"
          }
        ]
      }
      """
        .trimIndent()
    return fhirJson.decodeFromString(fallbackJson)
  }

460:    * Adds empty [QuestionnaireResponse.Item]s to `responseItems` so that each [Questionnaire.Item]
461:    * in `questionnaireItems` has at least one corresponding [QuestionnaireResponse.Item]. This is
462:    * because user-provided [QuestionnaireResponse] might not contain answers to unanswered or
463:    * disabled questions. This function should only be used for unpacked questionnaire.
464:    */
465:   @VisibleForTesting
466:   internal fun addMissingResponseItems(
467:     questionnaireItems: List<Questionnaire.Item>,
468:     responseItems: MutableList<QuestionnaireResponse.Item>,
469:   ) {
470:     // To associate the linkId to QuestionnaireResponse.Item, do not use associateBy().
471:     // Instead, use groupBy().
472:     // This is because a questionnaire response may have multiple
473:     // QuestionnaireResponseItemComponents with the same linkId.
474:     val responseItemMap = responseItems.groupBy { it.linkId }
475: 
476:     // Clear the response item list, and then add the missing and existing response items back to
477:     // the list
478:     responseItems.clear()
479: 
480:     questionnaireItems.forEach {
481:       if (responseItemMap[it.linkId].isNullOrEmpty()) {
482:         responseItems.add(it.createQuestionnaireResponseItem().build())
483:       } else {
484:         if (
485:           it.type.value == Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemType.Group && it.repeats?.value != true
486:         ) {
487:           addMissingResponseItems(
488:             questionnaireItems = it.item,
489:             responseItems = responseItemMap[it.linkId]!!.single().item.toMutableList(),
490:           )
491:         }
492:         if (
493:           it.type.value == Questionnaire.QuestionnaireItemType.Group && it.repeats?.value == true
494:         ) {
495:           responseItemMap[it.linkId]!!.forEach { rItem ->
496:             addMissingResponseItems(
497:               questionnaireItems = it.item,
498:               responseItems = rItem.item.toMutableList(),
499:             )
500:           }
501:         }
502:         responseItems.addAll(responseItemMap[it.linkId]!!)
503:       }
504:     }

703:   /**
704:    * Updates all items that has [dev.ohs.fhir.datacapture.extensions.calculatedExpression] that
705:    * reference the given [questionnaireItem] within their calculations.
706:    *
707:    * If item X has a [dev.ohs.fhir.datacapture.extensions.calculatedExpression], but that item does
708:    * not reference the given [questionnaireItem], then item X should not be calculated.
709:    *
710:    * Only items that have not been modified by the user will be updated to prevent any event loops.
711:    *
712:    * @param questionnaireItem The questionnaire item referenced by other items through
713:    *   [dev.ohs.fhir.datacapture.extensions.calculatedExpression].
714:    */
715:   private suspend fun updateAnswerWithAffectedCalculatedExpression(
716:     questionnaireItem: Questionnaire.Item,
717:     questionnaireResponseItem: QuestionnaireResponse.Item,
718:   ) {
719:     expressionEvaluator
720:       .evaluateAllAffectedCalculatedExpressions(questionnaireItem, questionnaireResponseItem)
721:       .forEach { (questionnaireItem, calculatedAnswers) ->
722:         // update all response item with updated values
723:         questionnaireResponse.value
724:           .toBuilder()
725:           .allItems
726:           // Item answer should not be modified and touched by user;
727:           // https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/sdc/StructureDefinition-sdc-questionnaire-calculatedExpression.html
728:           .filter {
729:             it.linkId == questionnaireItem.linkId &&
730:               !modifiedQuestionnaireResponseItemSet.contains(it)
731:           }
732:           .forEach { questionnaireResponseItem ->
733:             // update and notify only if new answer has changed to prevent any event loop
734:             if (questionnaireResponseItem.answer.hasDifferentAnswerSet(calculatedAnswers)) {
735:               questionnaireResponseItem.toBuilder().apply {
736:                 answer =
737:                   calculatedAnswers.mapNotNullTo(mutableListOf()) {
738:                     when (it) {
739:                       is FhirR4Boolean -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Boolean(it)
740:                       is Decimal -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Decimal(it)
741:                       is Integer -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Integer(it)
742:                       is FhirR4String -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.String(it)
743:                       is Coding -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Coding(it)
744:                       is Reference -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Reference(it)
745:                       is Date -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Date(it)
746:                       is DateTime -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.DateTime(it)
747:                       is Time -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Time(it)
748:                       is Uri -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Uri(it)
749:                       is Attachment -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Attachment(it)
750:                       is Quantity -> QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Value.Quantity(it)
751:                       else -> null
752:                     }?.let { item ->
753:                       QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Answer.Builder().apply { value = item }
754:                     }
755:                   }
756:               }
757:             }
758:           }
759:       }

1087:       // Add nested questions after the parent item. We need to get the questionnaire items and
1088:       // (possibly multiple sets of) matching questionnaire response items and generate the adapter
1089:       // items. There are three different cases:
1090:       // 1. Questions nested under a non-repeated group: Simply take the nested question items and
1091:       // the nested question response items and "zip" them.
1092:       // 2. Questions nested under a question: In this case, the nested questions are repeated for
1093:       // each answer to the parent question. Therefore, we need to take the questions and lists of
1094:       // questionnaire response items nested under each answer and generate multiple sets of adapter
1095:       // items.
1096:       // 3. Questions nested under a repeated group: In the in-memory questionnaire response in the
1097:       // view model, we create dummy answers for each repeated group. As a result the processing of
1098:       // this case is similar to the case of questions nested under a question.
1099:       // For background, see https://build.fhir.org/questionnaireresponse.html#link.
1100: 
1101:       // Case 1: Non-repeated group - process nested items directly with current prefix
1102:       if (
1103:         !questionnaireItem.isRepeatedGroup && evaluatedQuestionnaireResponseItem.item.isNotEmpty()
1104:       ) {
1105:         addAll(
1106:           getQuestionnaireAdapterItems(
1107:             questionnaireItemList = questionnaireItem.item.filterNot { it.isDisplayItem },
1108:             questionnaireResponseItemList = evaluatedQuestionnaireResponseItem.item,
1109:             parentIdPrefix = parentIdPrefix,
1110:           )
1111:         )
1112:       }
1113: 
1114:       // Case 2 and 3: Questions nested under answers (for questions with nested items or repeated
1115:       // groups)
1116:       evaluatedQuestionnaireResponseItem.answer
1117:         .map { it.item }
1118:         .forEachIndexed { index, nestedResponseItemList ->
1119:           val currentIdPrefix =
1120:             if (!questionnaireItem.isRepeatedGroup) {
1121:               // Case 2: Questions nested under a question (not a repeated group)
1122:               if (parentIdPrefix.isEmpty()) {
1123:                 "${index}_${question.item.questionnaireItem.linkId.value}_"
1124:               } else {
1125:                 "${parentIdPrefix}${index}_${question.item.questionnaireItem.linkId.value}_"
1126:               }
1127:             } else {
1128:               // Case 3: Build hierarchical ID prefix for nested repeated groups
1129:               "${parentIdPrefix}${index}_${question.item.questionnaireItem.linkId.value}_"
1130:             }
1131: 
1132:           if (questionnaireItem.isRepeatedGroup) {
1133:             // Case 3
1134:             add(
1135:               QuestionnaireAdapterItem.RepeatedGroupHeader(
1136:                 id = "${parentIdPrefix}${index}_${question.item.questionnaireItem.linkId.value}",
1137:                 index = index,
1138:                 onDeleteClicked = { viewModelScope.launch { question.item.removeAnswerAt(index) } },
1139:                 responses = nestedResponseItemList,
1140:                 title = question.item.questionText?.toString() ?: "",
1141:               )
1142:             )
1143:           }
1144:           addAll(
1145:             getQuestionnaireAdapterItems(
1146:               // If nested display item is identified as instructions or flyover, then do not
1147:               // create questionnaire state for it.
1148:               questionnaireItemList = questionnaireItem.item.filterNot { it.isDisplayItem },
1149:               questionnaireResponseItemList = nestedResponseItemList,
1150:               parentIdPrefix = currentIdPrefix,
1151:             )
1152:           )
1153:         }

1155:       if (questionnaireItem.isRepeatedGroup) {
1156:         add(
1157:           QuestionnaireAdapterItem.RepeatedGroupAddButton(
1158:             id = "${parentIdPrefix}${question.item.questionnaireItem.linkId.value}_add_btn",
1159:             item = question.item,
1160:           )
1161:         )
1162:       }
1163:     }

1166:   }

1168:   /**

1170:    * This will also prevent any questionnaire item that depends on the answer of this questionnaire
1171:    * item to be wrongly evaluated as well.

1173:   private fun cacheDisabledQuestionnaireItemAnswers(
1174:     questionnaireResponseItem: QuestionnaireResponse.Item
1175:   ) {
1176:     if (questionnaireResponseItem.answer.isNotEmpty()) {
1177:       responseItemToAnswersMapForDisabledQuestionnaireItem[questionnaireResponseItem] =
1178:         questionnaireResponseItem.answer

1180:     }

1187:     questionnaireResponseItem: QuestionnaireResponse.Item
1188:   ) {
1189:     if (responseItemToAnswersMapForDisabledQuestionnaireItem.contains(questionnaireResponseItem)) {
1190:       questionnaireResponseItem.toBuilder().apply {
1191:         answer =
1192:           responseItemToAnswersMapForDisabledQuestionnaireItem
1193:             .remove(questionnaireResponseItem)

1201:     questionnaireItemList: List<Questionnaire.Item>,
1202:     questionnaireResponseItemList: List<QuestionnaireResponse.Item>,
1203:   ): List<QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Builder> {
1204:     val responseItemKeys = questionnaireResponseItemList.map { it.linkId }
1205:     val result = mutableListOf<QuestionnaireResponse.Item.Builder>()

1207:     for ((questionnaireItem, questionnaireResponseItem) in
1208:       questionnaireItemList.zip(questionnaireResponseItemList)) {

1212:       ) {

1219:               }

1231:                   it.item.map { itemBuilder -> itemBuilder.build() },
1232:                 )
1233:                 .toMutableList()
1234:           }
1235:         }

1237:       }

1249:         index,

1265:   private fun validateCurrentPageItems(block: () -> Unit) {
1266:     if (
1267:       currentPageItems.filterIsInstance<QuestionnaireAdapterItem.Question>().any {
1268:         it.item.validationResult is NotValidated
1269:       }
1270:     ) {

1272:       // This will ensure that all fields are validated even when they're not filled by the user
1273:       currentPageItems.filterIsInstance<QuestionnaireAdapterItem.Question>().forEach {
1274:         modifiedQuestionnaireResponseItemSet.add(it.item.getQuestionnaireResponseItem())
1275:       }
1276:       // Results in a new questionnaire state being generated synchronously, i.e., the current
1277:       // thread will be suspended until the new state is generated.
1278:       modificationCount.update { it + 1 }

1281:     if (
1282:       currentPageItems.filterIsInstance<QuestionnaireAdapterItem.Question>().all {
1283:         it.item.validationResult is Valid
1284:       }
1285:     ) {
1286:       block()
